walkthroughs.body_html:
Component 3: Externally Set Assignment — a core area of GCSE Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Component 3: Externally Set Assignment brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 3: Externally Set Assignment.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Why is understanding patronage important for studying historical art?
options: Patrons commissioned art for specific purposes, shaping content and form.
Artists worked freely - patronage was irrelevant to the artwork.
Patrons painted the works themselves.
The space between letters.

mcqs.q: What were Impressionist painters primarily trying to capture?

The space between letters.
Photographic accuracy.
The space between letters.
A whole typeface that looks formal.
The small projecting line at the end of letter strokes.
